src: # WLO-0094 — Accessible logbook editing, deletion and reliable Undo
text: WLO-0101 independent implementation review at d41a60a: changes requested. R03 [P1] Undo failure is followed by automatic destruction of its recovery copy; R04 [P1] Two fast deletes can overwrite the single recovery record; R10 [P2] Logbook and overview history still compute the old daily-minimum summary. Full source anchors, reproduction steps, fixes and the 79-scenario ledger: docs/tech/WLO-0101-IMPLEMENTATION-REVIEW.md. Evidence: docs/tech/WLO-0101-evidence/. This comment records review findings; it does not change the ticket status.
